def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The grid is a 5-by-3 arrangement of rooms divided by complete
    # rows/columns of color 9. Mark a room 1 when it contains at least
    # two cells of color 4; otherwise mark it with its background color 8.
    sep = 9
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + hr + [h], [-1] + vc + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
                     for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])]
            row.append(1 if cells.count(4) >= 2 else 8)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    # Compress the repeating lattice by sampling each intersection of
    # horizontal and vertical 7-lines; a marked crossing is represented
    # by the room/background color, not by the line color.
    rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 7 in row and row.count(7)>len(row)//2]
    cols=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if sum(row[c]==7 for row in grid)>len(grid)//2]
    # Keep the lattice intersections and map the special crossing marker 5
    # to the enclosed field color.
    return [[1 if grid[r][c]==5 else grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]

def transform(grid):
    # Every fourth row/column is a tile boundary in the demo set. The
    # output is the matrix of colors at those boundary intersections,
    # with outermost perimeter omitted.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Detect periodic lattice spacing from rows/columns dominated by one
    # boundary color; sample boundary intersections at that interval.
    def boundaries_line(values):
        return len(set(values)) <= 2
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if boundaries_line(grid[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if boundaries_line([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)])]
    # output values correspond to crossings inside the lattice, excluding
    # the initial boundary and taking every detected horizontal/vertical.
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols[1:-1]] for r in rows[1:-1]]
